Rem.why: Coin-flip support whose percent-max-HP heal gains relative value now that stacked anti-heal caps at 72% instead of 82.2%; still loses the heal-slot duel to Ivy and the Mo & Krill buffs sharpen a listed loss.
Rem.notes:
11-04 Minor: no direct change; Healbane's stacked heal-cut ceiling 82.2->72% protects his percent-HP heal from multi-source anti-heal, but Mo & Krill's Scorn/Burrow buffs sharpen a listed loss — held D/rising.

10-20 Shh...: no direct change; harder corridor camps raise the value of his percent-max-HP heal on the farm route, but Healing Snacks do part of his job for free and he still loses the heal-slot duel to Ivy — held B/rising.

09-29 City Never Sleeps: no direct change; harder camps reward his sustain and spread-out vaults (Bell Tower now three) strengthen his map play, while Healing Snacks slightly cheapen dedicated healing - trend up (peercontent).

Celeste.why: Flying spirit burster whose pick tools all shrank — silence T3 +1.25->+0.75s, Radiant Daggers 30->25m, Shining Wonder slow/cooldown/bounce/damage down — on top of the 10-30 sustain-shell gutting, so she has neither a safe angle nor a reliable pick window.
Celeste.notes:
11-04 Minor: C -> D. Dazzling Trick T3 silence +1.25->+0.75s, Radiant Daggers 30->25m and 7->6% spirit amp, Shining Wonder slow -32->-28%, cooldown 160->170s, bounce 15.5->15m, T2 +90->+80 — every pick tool shrank at once.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: B -> C. Shining Wonder 140->125 is the note; the real hit is Radiant Regeneration (0.35->0.25 spirit regen scaling, heal-on-cast 65->40, in-combat only) plus Healing Booster losing Extra Regen and +3 flat regen, into buffed Decay/Toxic Bullets/stacking Healbane. Spirit Shielding 18->15%, HVR 60->45% velocity and Metal Skin's +20% gravity compound it; pivot to Spirit Lifesteal + Torment Pulse.

10-20 Shh...: no direct change; the off-lane/corridor economy gives her no camp or crate income route, and Barrel Mimics tax a low-HP clearer, so the tempo patch keeps her B/falling.

Rat King.why: Still the 116-heavy-melee frontline who opens Tough Crates and forces hub fights, and 11-04 gave back exactly what 10-30 took — ammo 24->26, bullet damage 5.7->5.8, banner move speed +4m and a -25s ult-cooldown talent — so his camp-clear and reset are back online.
Rat King.notes:
11-04 Minor: S held. Bullet damage 5.7->5.8, ammo 24->26, Rule, Ratannia! move speed +3->+4m and T1 now -25s cooldown; Scrap Grenade fuse-extension 0.4->0.25s makes the melee-fuse trick less reliable.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: S -> A. Scrap Grenade 70->60 (T2 +70->+60, T3 300->275), fuse +0.1s; Rule, Ratannia! knockup halved, 160->180s and now goes on cooldown if he is stunned before placing; base bullet -5% and growth -20%. Haunt camps +10% HP finish the one-button clear. Offsets: Heavy-Melee Cauldrons, Healing Snacks 10->14%.

10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Tough Crates, grouped chasing Haunts, forced Bell Tower/Sunken Plaza hubs and Barrel Mimics all point at heavy-melee camp-clear frontlines, so the systems patch lifts him A -> S on fit, not numbers - confirm against win rate before locking.

Baba.why: Grounded regen bruiser whose resist wall and melee both got cut again — Spirit Resistance scaling 0.7->0.5, melee damage -10% per boon, Granny melee/debuff resist 30->25% — so the crate-clear and brawl durability that carried her S tier are thinner, even at a 54.4% win rate.
Baba.notes:
11-04 Minor: S -> A. Spirit Resistance scaling 0.7->0.5, melee damage -10% per boon, Granny Long Legs melee/debuff resist 30->25%, Baba's Brew cooldown 27->28s, cycle 1.5->1.6s and burn scaling 0.15->0.13 — the resist wall and crate-clear both thinner.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: C -> D. Baba's Brew order is random each cast on a 1->1.5s cycle (silence 3->2.75s), spirit-resist scaling 0.1->0.07, Threadsap 22->16s and cleanse now wipes stolen spirit, Granny heavy-melee slow 4->2s; Radiant Regeneration (94% buy) and Healing Booster both gutted into an anti-heal patch. Offsets: Heavy-Melee Cauldrons, Healing Snacks 10->14%.

10-20 Shh...: no direct change; the new corridors, grouped Haunt camps and forced Bell Tower/Plaza fights suit her melee-regen clear and arrest the post-10-14 fall, but the barrier/resist cuts still bind - trend falling -> stable at C.

Solomon.why: Zone-control support whose Bishop is the damage while his gun lane stays gutted; two of his three worst lanes (Baba, Celeste) were nerfed in 11-04, but Rat King — the third — was buffed, so the floor rises without a tier move.
Solomon.notes:
11-04 Minor: no direct change; Baba (spirit-resist scaling 0.7->0.5, melee -10%) and Celeste (silence/cast range/ult) were nerfed, but Rat King — his other listed loss — was buffed, so the floor rises without a tier move — held D/stable.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: base bullet 30->25 and -20% headshot gut the HVR/Opening Rounds lane crutch, Rook Battery 1.3->0.9 scaling is a real damage cut, Develop Queen 210->240s; Setup Bishop is now the damage (0.64->0.85 on-square, T1 slow +25%, T3 shred -5%/stack on impact) and checkmate is base kit. Max Bishop over Rook Battery. Three losing matchups (Rat King, Baba, Celeste) ate major nerfs. C held.

7-day check-in (2026-10-16): tier B -> C, WR 45%, PR 61% over 329000 matches. Usage overrides the day-0 'Barrier support' and full-gun builds: Divine Barrier/Healbane/Healing Booster/Superior Duration and Swift Striker do not appear in high-rank item data. Vindicta now reads 48% (even), not the day-0 loss; Baba still 36% despite the 10-14 front-line cut (her barrier 1.2->0.7, -7% bullet resist, B->C).

Deadman Danny.why: Spirit mark-burster whose dive-pick identity got taxed again — Close The Deal execute +75->+55%, Strix Salvo spirit scaling -8%, Chimera Mk1 T2 heal 150->125 — on a 730-HP flyer who must commit; the mark no longer finishes targets above half HP.
Deadman Danny.notes:
11-04 Minor: A -> B. Close The Deal execute +75->+55%, Strix Salvo spirit scaling -8%, Chimera Mk1 T2 heal 150->125 and heal scaling 2.0->1.7 — the dive-pick pays less and the mark no longer finishes targets above half HP.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: Chimera Mk1 nerfed across the board — jetpack unusable while cursed, slows now cut jetpack impulse harder (worse under movement-ability silence), grounding pulls land more reliably. HVR 60->45% velocity hits his lone weapon staple; the Close The Deal damage fix is the only gain. C held, trend rising -> stable.

7-day check-in (2026-10-20): tier C -> C, WR 45%, PR 69% over 446352 matches. Corrected: the usage data kills the 'shred/mark gun' identity - Bullet Resist Shredder does not appear at all, and the real build is spirit (Extra/Improved Spirit, Mystic Burst at 79-90%) with HV Rounds as the lone weapon staple. The old beats list was inverted - Celeste (33%) and Graves (32%) are among his worst lanes, not wins. PR 69.1% is a new-hero novelty spike (previously 0.2% on a two-day sample), so read WR 38.5% and ignore pick rate. Held C/rising: the build finally consolidated and WR gained ~3.6 points, but nothing clears 49% head-to-head and the flyer tax is intact; upgrade only on ~45%+ WR, drop to D if the spirit capstone stays a post-30-min luxury.

Violet.why: Zone caster whose ult was cut on every axis at 10-30 and whose regen stack (Radiant Regeneration 96%, Mystic Regeneration 93%, Healing Booster 78%) now faces a weaker stacked anti-heal ceiling (82.2->72%), the one item-side relief her build needed; still 50.8% and no escape.
Violet.notes:
11-04 Minor: no direct change; Healbane's stacked heal-cut ceiling 82.2->72% is the one item-side relief for her Radiant Regeneration/Mystic Regeneration/Healing Booster stack, while Baba's resist/melee cuts soften a listed loss and Rat King's buffs worsen another — held B, trend falling -> stable.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: B -> C. Abstract Landscape 165->180s, 0.04->0.01 duration scaling, ends on death, 0.5->0.75s re-apply and T3 ink destructible again; Still Life stun 1.0->0.9s, LOS required at channel end, T1 regen only while drawing (0.25->0.15). Spirit Lifesteal 6->8 spirit / 13->15% is the replacement sustain; anti-heal stacking taxes the rest.

7-day check-in (2026-10-23): tier B -> C, WR 50%, PR 64% over 539876 matches. Data corrects the day-0 read: B/rising was a tooltip judgment, so C is a correction, not a decline — 46.1% WR at 70.9% PR, and she loses to frontline brawlers rather than punishing melee. Watch whether her WR climbs with reps; the tooltip read also claimed Seven and the gun line as wins, but Seven is 49% over 170 and Living Ink/HVR no longer appear in her item data at all. 10-20 Shh...: no Violet changes; her position moves on systems (Haunt grouping, Tough Crates, hub fights) and on the dive/frontline meta around her.

Nurse Harrow.why: Marksman-healer whose Lurking Terrors now fears faster (2->1.75s) and wider (vertical 50->65%) with +8% bullet damage, steadying a falling A-tier; her sustain is still healing-based into a weaker stacked anti-heal ceiling but single-source anti-heal still answers her.
Nurse Harrow.notes:
11-04 Minor: A held. Bullet damage +8%, Lurking Terrors fear buildup 2->1.75s and vertical angle 50->65% — faster, wider lockdown steadies a falling A-tier; single-source anti-heal still answers her healing-based sustain.

10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: Lurking Terrors fear buildup 1.3->2s, T3 immunity -> 50% damage reduction, no fear from >50° above/below the target's view; base gun damage -10%, Healing Needles 25->22 (T2 +20->+16) but spirit scaling 0.2->0.24; Leech Therapy ground leeches 180s -> 120s + 3s/min and cleared on round reset. Anti-heal buffs land on a dedicated healer. B held, trend stable -> falling.

7-day check-in (2026-10-27): tier B -> B, WR 51%, PR 63% over 607252 matches. Data overrides the day-0 read: Swift Striker, High-Velocity Rounds and Active Reload show no meaningful share (Titanic Magazine is the weapon core at 98% / 6.7m), and the 7-day spread contains none of the dash assassins the fear-cone thesis predicted. Extra Regen is not the trap the previous note called it — 97% at 2.1m with a baseline win rate makes it a mandatory lane tax for 0 base regen, indifferent rather than informative. Changelog: released 2026-10-20 in Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit., first full-week check (7.3k matches, no creator content); nearly every item WR sits at 50.5-51%, so build-level signals are weak and confidence is capped.
